dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple closed-loop 'O' shaped geometries are visible on the dorsal-posterior region, characterized by a high-contrast boundary transitioning from a dark charcoal exterior to a light gray interior. Perimeters exhibit irregular curvatures and vary in diameter.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high concentration of diffuse, high-intensity tan/white pixels is located in the anterior-ventral region. Localized clusters of solid dark-intensity pixels are interspersed between macro-annuli in the posterior section.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form an irregular quadrilateral. A secondary arrangement of three lower-lateral annuli centroids forms an obtuse triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: A large, continuous high-intensity tan-colored region occupies the anterior cranial and neck area, creating a significant color contrast with the surrounding darker dorsal patterns.
